text_block_list.text:
After our outing, Red Desire and I decided 
to walk home through the park.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Lush green scenery... brings such peace to 
my heart. Perhaps because it resembles the 
other world.
choice_data_list: Then shall we take a little detour?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh... thank you very much. Now then, let 
us take a stroll while sensing the mana of 
nature—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Oh? Isn't that... Cafe-san over there?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the woods all alone...? I 
wonder what's the matter.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-san has such a stern look on her 
face... I'm worried, so why don't we go 
speak to her?
choice_data_list: Wait, I have a bad feeling about this—
Wait, something feels off—

text_block_list.text:
Sensing an ominous presence, I stepped in 
front of Red Desire and stopped her—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah, stop! Don't get any closer—

All of a sudden, my body feels so 
heavy...! Almost like someone is lying on 
top of me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Could it be, Trainer...?! I'm so sorry, it 
was my carelessness...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Carelessness...? What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Actually... an inhuman entity was 
wandering... this very park.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I was leading it to an uninhabited area so 
it wouldn't harm anyone, but... it ended 
up possessing you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: N-No way...! Are you okay, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: My body feels so heavy...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a terrible complexion...! At this 
rate, Trainer is going to...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry. I will take full 
responsibility and handle it—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... No, let me handle this! I 
wouldn't be worthy of being a Saint if I 
just overlooked Trainer's crisis......!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Desire-san, you're prepared to go that 
far... ...In that case, I will leave 
Trainer-san in your hands...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O Holy Light, obey the Saint's command... 
and purge the curse eroding that soul!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
How is it, Trainer! Has the heaviness in 
your body gone away...?
choice_data_list:
If anything, it's just getting heavier and 
heavier...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
What a curse...! Still, I cannot give up! 
More prayers, more holy power...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(The precious person who showed me what it 
means to be a Saint— I must save her with 
these very hands! On my pride as a 
Saint—!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O wicked one, evil spirit... Begone this 
instant! Lest judgment be passed upon you!

As I listened to Red Desire's earnest 
voice, the heavy weight on my shoulders 
suddenly lifted—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*... Trainer! How was it, did 
the curse—
choice_data_list: Ah... My body feels so light!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness...! The saint's prayers 
have been answered!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... not yet. This time, I'll go to 
Desire-san—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, my body suddenly feels heavy— but…… 
as long as Trainer is safe, everything's 
fine……"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Sacrificing oneself to save the people is 
also the true duty of a holy maiden, after 
all... Ah, how magnificent...!
choice_data_list: You can't do that!
No way, you can't!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Trainer? Those hands... are you 
praying for me?"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't! You were finally saved, but 
you'll end up possessed again!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I do not mind suffering! For it is a trial 
that I must overcome!
choice_data_list: Supporting you is my duty, too...!
Supporting you is part of my duty too...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
To care about me that much... But I can't 
let you sacrifice yourself, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O wicked one, if you must possess someone, 
let it be me! I shall take on that curse!
choice_data_list: No, let me do it!
No, let me do it!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's you, Trainer, I won't back 
down! Please let me carry out my duty as a 
Saint!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah— Oh? My body feels 
lighter...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Which means, don't tell me... it happened 
to Trainer-san again?
choice_data_list: No, I still feel light as a feather too!
No, mine are still feeling light too!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"They've left. Presumably, well... 
completely exasperated—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufu... My prayers were answered! This 
is the true power of a saintly maiden!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. If your unwavering 
conviction finally wore them down, then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The purity of their hearts caring for one 
another repelled the curse... Perhaps one 
could call it the prayer of a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! To receive your approval, 
Cafe-san... I am truly honored...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It was a severe trial, but thanks to it, I 
was able to grow as a saint...!
choice_data_list: As expected of the saint.
As expected of the saint.
Glad I could be of help too.
I'm glad I could be of help, too.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It was a severe trial, but thanks to it, I 
was able to grow as a saint...!
choice_data_list: As expected of the saint.
As expected of the saint.
Glad I could be of help too.
I'm glad I could be of help, too.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... With this, Trainer, you won't have 
anything to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what misfortune befalls you from 
here on, you have the protection of the 
Saintess... I shall protect you with all 
my might♪

Red Desire's confident smile truly seemed 
to shine brilliantly—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you have my gratitude... However... 
please refrain from doing something as 
reckless as this in the future.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If anything were to happen to you... Just 
the thought makes me so anxious. Promise 
me, okay?

Hearing Red Desire's slightly dissatisfied 
words, I gave a wry smile and nodded—
